answer: The willow register is checked at draw time, delta lists the eligible set, and sonnet seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 26 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 26 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 10 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
